title: Determination of the Balance Taken from a Departing Hotel Rate Plans Guest
content:
This determination settles the balance taken from a departing guest's card on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation.

## 1. The nights and the nightly rate

The nights of the stay already covered on the folio are taken as the highest night sequence the folio's room lines carry.

The booked nightly rate is the room lines and the prepayment lines posted on the reservation taken together and divided by the nights of the stay already covered on the folio multiplied by the rooms held; the divisor is those nights multiplied by the rooms held, taken together as one figure.

## 2. What is charged

The room money charged is the room lines and the prepayment lines posted together with the occupant supplement posted.

0 percent of the statutory tax posted is charged.

The property facility fee posted on the reservation is charged in full, being owed per room per night on every plan that does not waive it.

0 percent of the charges taken at the property is charged.

## 3. What is set against the balance

0 percent of the credit drawn down is set against the balance.

0 percent of the deposit taken is set against the balance.

No conversion markup is added.

## 4. Striking the balance

The balance settled at departure is the room money charged plus the statutory tax charged plus the property facility fee posted on the reservation plus the charges taken at the property charged, less the credit offset and less the deposit offset, and the conversion markup is then added to that figure.

The balance is never less than nothing. Every figure is rounded to two decimal places as it is worked out, and the balance is rounded the same way.

## 5. Worked on hypothetical figures

Take a reservation holding 1 room over 4 nights, whose folio carries room lines of 900.00 USD reaching a highest night sequence of 3, prepayment lines of 300.00 USD, an occupant supplement of 240.00 USD, statutory tax of 200.00 USD, a property facility fee of 140.00 USD, charges taken at the property of 85.00 USD and property credit drawn down of 40.00 USD.

1. The nights already covered on the folio are 3, and the booked nightly rate is 1,200.00 USD divided by 3 nights multiplied by 1 room, which is 400.00 USD.
2. The room money charged is 900.00 USD and 300.00 USD taken together with the 240.00 USD occupant supplement, which is 1,440.00 USD.
3. The statutory tax charged is 0 percent of 200.00 USD, which is 0.00 USD.
4. The property facility fee posted is charged in full, being 140.00 USD.
5. The charges taken at the property charged are 0 percent of 85.00 USD, which is 0.00 USD.
6. The credit offset is 0 percent of 40.00 USD, which is 0.00 USD, and the deposit offset is 0 percent of 300.00 USD, which is 0.00 USD.
7. The balance is 1,440.00 USD plus 0.00 USD plus 140.00 USD plus 0.00 USD, less 0.00 USD and less 0.00 USD, giving 1,580.00 USD; no conversion markup is added, and the figure is not below nothing. The balance settled at departure is **1,580.00 USD**.
